opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an established independent researcher based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, hold a permanent or fixed‑term position, have teaching and admin duties, and be able to involve a co‑applicant from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Supports interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the social sciences, humanities, engineering and natural sciences, encouraging collaboration between the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; must have completed viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award to support independent research leading to a publishable output, funded by DSIT, covering salary and research costs.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher education institution or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £10,000 to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills, supporting methodological innovation and interdisciplinary collaboration.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, holding an established role, with at least 20% FTE on the award; must involve overseas co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Supports 24‑month projects on mobilities, integrating SHAPE and STEM disciplines, to develop international research led by humanities/social sciences.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, eligible to work at DGAP in Berlin for a year.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, or strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £4,000 (or higher in exceptional cases) to cover equipment, caring costs, accessibility or support needed to make an application or conduct research.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers in any career stage, working in the humanities or social sciences, able to partner with a gallery, archive, library, museum or performing arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funds public‑engagement projects delivering innovative activities with GLAM or performing arts venues.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions, working in the humanities or social sciences, interested in the theme ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.
opportunities.summary: Provides travel, accommodation and visa support for up to fifteen UK and fifteen German early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day symposium and develop collaborative projects.
